figurative_meaning_en: Charming or beautiful arching of the eyebrows
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার ভ্রুবিলাসে সকলে মুগ্ধ হয়ে গেল।
কবিতায় বর্ণিত সেই নারীর ভ্রুবিলাস অপূর্ব ছিল।
example_sentences_in_english: Her playful arch of the eyebrows captivated everyone.
The poem described the woman's charming eyebrow gesture as exquisite.
history: Referenced in Rabindranath Tagore's works, such as the line 'ভ্রূবিলাস শেখে নাই কারা সেই নারী', highlighting classical Bengali poetic imagery of feminine allure.
note: This idiom draws from traditional Bengali aesthetics in literature, emphasizing subtle expressions of beauty.
